summary: Tree tower on Paddy Mountain, Centre County, built 1910 and no longer standing; no source gives a removal date or describes the site today.

facts.design: Tree tower with an observation platform about 25 feet above the ground
facts.status_note: Register says no longer standing; no removal date in the sources

events.note: Register date for the tree tower; the 1910-11 Department of Forestry report, as quoted on the weebly page, says two fire observation towers were built, one on Paddy Mountain
Register says the tower was still used circa 1917
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

evidence.supports: Tree tower built 1910, still used circa 1917, no longer standing
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1910, still used circa 1917, and is no longer standing.

evidence.supports: 1910-11 Department of Forestry report: two fire observation towers, one on top of Paddy Mountain
evidence.quote: Two fire observation towers were built, one on top of Paddy Mountain.

evidence.supports: 1910 entry: observation platform 25 feet above the ground
evidence.quote: A tree with observation platform at 25 feet above the ground.

evidence.supports: The 1910 entry comes from a Department of Forestry report of December 31, 1917
evidence.quote: Report of the Department of Forestry, December 31, 1917

sources.title: Paddy Mountain Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Both sources agree on 1910 and no longer standing, but both are short listings with no removal date, no present-day description and no access information. The register says one tree tower; the 1910-11 report quoted on the weebly page says two were built, one on Paddy Mountain. The register says 'No coordinates are available', so the brief's lat/lon (40.88813, -77.27887) has no source among the pages read. Access is unknown and was not set.
